visibility.title: AI visibility
visibility.description: See when AI systems fetch your publication, send readers, or cite it in monitored answers.
visibility.methodology: Crawler fetches and referrals are observed traffic. Citation coverage is a recurring sample of monitored prompts, not a count of every private AI conversation.

crawlers.title: AI discovery
crawlers.description: Server-observed requests, separated by answer engines, training crawlers, and classic search.
crawlers.empty: No recognised AI crawler has fetched this publication yet.

referrals.title: Confirmed AI referrals
referrals.description: Visits with an AI service as their referrer. Apps that omit referrers cannot be counted, so this is a lower bound.
referrals.empty: No confirmed AI referral has been recorded yet.

prompts.title: Monitored prompts
prompts.description: Topiqu checks these questions with live web search and stores the answer and cited URLs.
prompts.placeholder: What question should AI search answer?
prompts.empty: Add a buyer question or create suggestions from your focus and Search Console data.
prompts.premium: Citation checks are available on Premium and Custom plans.

runs.title: Recent citation checks
runs.empty: Run a monitored prompt to establish the first citation baseline.

opportunities.title: Visibility opportunities
opportunities.description: Repeated gaps only: other sources were cited in at least two samples while this publication was absent.
opportunities.empty: No repeated visibility gap has enough evidence yet.
